s001: Stop-motion claymation movement: the young woman gently slides the last food bowl forward and smiles softly at the cats; the three cats lower their heads and begin eating slowly, tails swaying. Slow camera push-in.
s002: Stop-motion claymation movement: the gloved hand gently lifts the ginger cat's lip a little further to show his teeth; the cat blinks slowly and his ears flatten with mild unease, whiskers twitching. Static camera.
s003: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet gestures reassuringly with an open hand and nods while talking; the old woman listens, gently stroking the grey cat in her arms, who blinks slowly. Static camera.
s004: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet slowly moves the stethoscope across the grey cat's chest and nods with satisfaction; the grey cat sits calmly, blinking and turning its head slightly. Slow camera push-in.
s005: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman leans in towards the carrier and smiles warmly at the grey cat; the grey cat blinks back calmly and its ears twitch. Slow camera push-in.
s006: Stop-motion claymation movement: thin wisps of steam rise slowly from the mug of tea; the phone lies still on the worktop and soft sunlight flickers gently through the window. Slow camera push-in.
s007: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman holds the phone to her ear, her face slowly falling into shock; her raised hand trembles and slowly drops towards her chest. Slow camera push-in.
s008: Stop-motion claymation movement: the gloved hands rest gently on the sleeping grey cat and stroke its side once; the cat stays limp and motionless while the monitor glows. Slow camera push-in.
s009: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly presses her hand harder to her mouth, her eyes welling up; her shoulders sink and she sways slightly where she stands. Slow camera push-in.
s010: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman sits motionless, clutching the empty carrier in her lap; her head bows slowly and her shoulders sink as she lets out a quiet breath. Static camera.
s011: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly strokes the sleeping grey cat on her lap and smiles tenderly; the cat breathes softly and the fire flickers gently behind them. Slow camera push-in.
s012: Stop-motion claymation movement: the grey cat blinks slowly and turns its head a little towards the framed photo of the old man; warm light shifts softly across the sideboard. Slow camera push-in.
s013: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet tilts the clipboard towards the old woman and taps the checklist with a smile; she clasps her hands and nods, relieved. Static camera.
s014: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet gently strokes the grey cat's head and smiles; the grey cat closes its eyes contentedly and leans into his hand. Static camera.
s015: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet slowly presses his hand to his forehead in disbelief, still holding the stethoscope to the motionless grey cat; the overhead lamp glows steadily. Slow camera push-in.
s016: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly turns the small collar over in her hands, a tear rolling down her cheek; she lowers her head and the fire flickers behind her. Slow camera push-in.
s017: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly lifts her fork, then lowers it without eating and stares at the empty chair opposite; the pendant lamp glows softly. Static camera.
s018: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman gently swings the carrier door open and smiles; the ginger cat inside blinks curiously and slowly sniffs the air. Slow camera push-in.
s019: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat nuzzles slowly against the old woman's cheek; she closes her eyes and smiles peacefully, her hand resting on the quilt. Static camera.
s020: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman's smile slowly fades as she looks up from her tea, her hands tightening gently around the mug; a worried crease forms on her brow. Slow camera push-in.
s021: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman stares ahead, her eyes glistening; she slowly wrings her clasped hands in her lap and swallows nervously. Slow camera push-in.
s022: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman climbs the stairs slowly, one step, her hand sliding along the banister; the ginger cat pauses on a step above and looks back at her. Static camera.
s023: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat sleeps peacefully, his side rising and falling; the old woman lies awake, eyes open, slowly turning her gaze towards the ceiling. Static camera.
s024: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman hugs herself tighter and looks slowly around the empty room; the fire flickers quietly and the empty cat bed stays still beside her. Slow pan right.
s025: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman lowers her gaze into her tea and her lips press together; she slowly sets the mug down on the table and her shoulders sag. Static camera.
s026: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly presses a hand to her stomach and looks down at the ginger cat; the ginger cat sniffs his food bowl and turns his head away. Slow camera push-in.
s027: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat winces and slowly rubs his cheek with his paw, one eye squeezed shut; his ears droop and his tail curls slowly. Slow camera push-in.
s028: Stop-motion claymation movement: the gloved hand slowly strokes the sleeping ginger cat's head; the cat's side rises gently with each breath as the overhead lamp glows. Slow camera push-in.
s029: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman hugs the ginger cat tightly and slowly rocks him, eyes squeezed shut; the cat nestles his head against her shoulder. Static camera.
s030: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly sweeps her hand along the products on the table and sighs, shaking her head slightly. The products stay completely still with their labels facing the camera. Static camera.
s031: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly brings the toothbrush towards the ginger cat's mouth; the cat leans back in the towel, ears flattening and eyes widening warily. Static camera.
s032: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat shuffles slowly further back under the table, ears flat; the old woman peeks under the quilt edge and reaches out a gentle hand. Static camera.
s033: Stop-motion claymation movement: a single drop slowly falls from the dropper into the water bowl, sending gentle ripples across the surface; the hand holds steady. Slow camera push-in.
s034: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman holds out the small treat; the ginger cat leans in slowly, sniffs it and takes it gently, while the fire flickers behind them. Static camera.
s035: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman gently lifts the ginger cat's lip and peers in, her face falling with worry; the cat flinches slightly and lowers his ears. Slow camera push-in.
s036: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman slowly lifts her head with quiet determination, takes a small sip of tea and nods to herself as sunlight drifts across the table. Slow pan left.
s037: Stop-motion claymation movement: the specialist points slowly along the X-ray with her pen while talking; the old woman leans forward slightly, listening intently and nodding. Static camera.
s038: Stop-motion claymation movement: the green germs bounce slowly on the yellow plaque and multiply by budding; the tooth looks down nervously, its arms trembling. Slow camera push-in.
s039: Stop-motion claymation movement: the yellow plaque slowly hardens and cracks spread across it; the tooth squeezes its eyes shut and hugs itself tighter while the germs grin. Static camera.
s040: Stop-motion claymation movement: the dog-bone biscuit bounces lightly off the tooth's head and slowly drifts away; the tooth frowns sideways at it and the plaque stays untouched. Static camera.
s041: Stop-motion claymation movement: the small cat-shaped biscuit drifts slowly past the tooth without touching the plaque; the tooth turns its eyes to follow it and sighs. Static camera.
s042: Stop-motion claymation movement: the water droplet slides slowly down over the plaque and drips away, leaving it unchanged; the tooth watches glumly and its shoulders droop. Static camera.
s043: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat chews slowly at his bowl and swallows, his cheek wincing slightly; a few kibbles roll gently on the floor. Slow camera push-in.
s044: Stop-motion claymation movement: the red gums slowly shrink back from the base of the tooth, revealing a gap; the tooth grimaces and its knees tremble slightly. Slow camera push-in.
s045: Stop-motion claymation movement: the germs slowly wriggle deeper down the dark pockets towards the root; the tooth above looks down anxiously, its arms shaking. Slow camera push-in.
s046: Stop-motion claymation movement: brown rot slowly creeps up the cracks at the base of the tooth as the germs gnaw; the tooth's eyes widen in alarm and it leans back slightly. Slow camera push-in.
s047: Stop-motion claymation movement: the germs drift slowly along the red blood vessel towards the kidneys; the two little teeth watch anxiously and the kidneys pulse gently. Slow pan right.
s048: Stop-motion claymation movement: the vet carefully works the small dental tool along the sleeping ginger cat's gumline; the cat's side rises and falls gently as the monitor glows. Static camera.
s049: Stop-motion claymation movement: the germs slowly burrow deeper into the cracks below the tooth while the tooth shakes its head sadly and droops its arms. Static camera.
s050: Stop-motion claymation movement: the old woman looks up hopefully, tilting her head and parting her lips as if asking a question; she slowly sets her mug down. Slow camera push-in.
s051: Stop-motion claymation movement: the hand slowly tips the scoop and the pale powder sprinkles gently over the cat food in the bowl. Static camera.
s052: Stop-motion claymation movement: the ginger cat slowly licks his lips and smiles contentedly as the golden sparkles drift gently upward from his tummy to his mouth. Slow camera push-in.
